inductive MemoryBlockState
| free
| allocated
| entangled
| migrating
deriving Repr, BEq, Inhabited

def MemoryBlockState.toUInt8 (s : MemoryBlockState) : UInt8 :=
  match s with
  | .free => 0
  | .allocated => 1
  | .entangled => 2
  | .migrating => 3

def MemoryBlockState.ofUInt8 (u : UInt8) : Option MemoryBlockState :=
  match u with
  | 0 => some .free
  | 1 => some .allocated
  | 2 => some .entangled
  | 3 => some .migrating
  | _ => none

theorem MemoryBlockState_toUInt8_ofUInt8 (s : MemoryBlockState) :
  (MemoryBlockState.ofUInt8 (s.toUInt8)) = some s := by
  cases s <;> simp [MemoryBlockState.toUInt8, MemoryBlockState.ofUInt8]

def ByteArray.lt (a b : ByteArray) : Bool :=
  let rec (i : Nat) : Bool :=
    if i < a.size && i < b.size then
      if a[i]! < b[i]! then true
      else if a[i]! > b[i]! then false
      else rec (i + 1)
    else a.size < b.size
  rec 0

instance : LT ByteArray where
  lt := ByteArray.lt

instance : Ord ByteArray where
  compare a b :=
    if ByteArray.lt a b then .lt
    else if ByteArray.lt b a then .gt
    else .eq

instance : DecidableRel (fun a b : ByteArray => a < b) := fun a b =>
  match compare a b with
  | .lt => isTrue (by decide)
  | _ => isFalse (by decide)

def writeU64Little (out : ByteArray) (v : Nat) : ByteArray :=
  let rec (i : Nat) (x : Nat) (arr : ByteArray) : ByteArray :=
    if i < out.size then
      let b := (x &&& 0xFF).toUInt8
      rec (i + 1) (x >>> 8) (arr.set! i b)
    else arr
  termination_by out.size - i
  decreasing_by
    simp_wf
    apply Nat.sub_pos_of_lt
    assumption
  rec 0 v out

def writeI128Little (out : ByteArray) (v : Int) : ByteArray :=
  let ux := v.toNat.toUInt128
  let rec (i : Nat) (x : UInt128) (arr : ByteArray) : ByteArray :=
    if i < out.size then
      let b := x.toUInt8
      rec (i + 1) (x >>> 8) (arr.set! i b)
    else arr
  termination_by out.size - i
  decreasing_by
    simp_wf
    apply Nat.sub_pos_of_lt
    assumption
  rec 0 ux out

def bytesToHexLower (out : ByteArray) (input : ByteArray) : ByteArray :=
  let rec (i : Nat) (arr : ByteArray) : ByteArray :=
    if i < input.size then
      let b := input[i]!
      let hi := (b >>> 4).toNat
      let lo := (b &&& 0xF).toNat
      let h := if hi < 10 then '0'.toNat + hi else 'a'.toNat + (hi - 10)
      let l := if lo < 10 then '0'.toNat + lo else 'a'.toNat + (lo - 10)
      rec (i + 1) (arr.set! (2 * i) h.toUInt8 |>.set! (2 * i + 1) l.toUInt8)
    else arr
  termination_by input.size - i
  decreasing_by
    simp_wf
    apply Nat.sub_pos_of_lt
    assumption
  rec 0 out

def sha256_rotateRight (x : UInt64) (n : Nat) : UInt64 :=
  let n' := n % 64
  (x >>> n') ||| (x <<< (64 - n'))

def sha256_ch (x y z : UInt64) : UInt64 := (x &&& y) ^^^ (~x &&& z)
def sha256_maj (x y z : UInt64) : UInt64 := (x &&& y) ^^^ (x &&& z) ^^^ (y &&& z)
def sha256_sigma0 (x : UInt64) : UInt64 := sha256_rotateRight x 2 ^^^ sha256_rotateRight x 13 ^^^ sha256_rotateRight x 22
def sha256_sigma1 (x : UInt64) : UInt64 := sha256_rotateRight x 6 ^^^ sha256_rotateRight x 11 ^^^ sha256_rotateRight x 25
def sha256_gamma0 (x : UInt64) : UInt64 := sha256_rotateRight x 7 ^^^ sha256_rotateRight x 18 ^^^ (x >>> 3)
def sha256_gamma1 (x : UInt64) : UInt64 := sha256_rotateRight x 17 ^^^ sha256_rotateRight x 19 ^^^ (x >>> 10)

def sha256_prepare_w (chunk : Array UInt64) : Array UInt64 :=
  let mut w := Array.mkArray 64 (0:UInt64)
  for i in [:16] do
    w := w.set! i chunk[i]!
  let mut j := 16
  while j < 64 do
    let s0 := sha256_gamma0 (w[j-3]!)
    let s1 := sha256_gamma1 (w[j-8]!)
    let val := (w[j-16]! + s0 + w[j-7]! + s1).toUInt64
    w := w.set! j val
    j := j + 1
  termination_by 64 - j
  decreasing_by
    simp_wf
    apply Nat.sub_pos_of_lt
    assumption
  w

def sha256_transform (state : Array UInt64) (chunk : Array UInt64) : Array UInt64 :=
  let w := sha256_prepare_w chunk
  let rec (i : Nat) (a b c d e f g h : UInt64) : UInt64 × UInt64 × UInt64 × UInt64 × UInt64 × UInt64 × UInt64 × UInt64 :=
    if i < 64 then
      let s1 := sha256_sigma1 e
      let ch := sha256_ch e f g
      let temp1 := h + s1 + ch + (sha256_k i).toUInt64 + w[i]!
      let s0 := sha256_sigma0 a
      let maj := sha256_maj a b c
      let temp2 := s0 + maj
      rec (i + 1) (temp1 + temp2) a b c d (d + temp1) e f
    else (a, b, c, d, e, f, g, h)
  termination_by 64 - i
  decreasing_by
    simp_wf
    apply Nat.sub_pos_of_lt
    assumption
  let (na, nb, nc, nd, ne, nf, ng, nh) := rec 0 state[0]! state[1]! state[2]! state[3]! state[4]! state[5]! state[6]! state[7]!
  #[na + state[0]!, nb + state[1]!, nc + state[2]!, nd + state[3]!, ne + state[4]!, nf + state[5]!, ng + state[6]!, nh + state[7]!]

def sha256 (data : ByteArray) : ByteArray :=
  let init := #[0x6a09e667, 0xbb67ae85, 0x3c6ef372, 0xa54ff53a, 0x510e527f, 0x9b05688c, 0x1f83d9ab, 0x5be0cd19].map (λ x => x.toUInt64)
  let ml := data.size * 8
  let padded_len := ((data.size + 8 + 64) / 64) * 64
  let mut padded := Array.mkArray padded_len (0:UInt8)
  for i in [:data.size] do
    padded := padded.set! i data[i]!
  padded := padded.set! data.size 0x80
  padded := padded.set! (padded_len - 8) ((ml >>> 56).toUInt64 &&& 0xFF).toUInt8
  padded := padded.set! (padded_len - 7) ((ml >>> 48).toUInt64 &&& 0xFF).toUInt8
  padded := padded.set! (padded_len - 6) ((ml >>> 40).toUInt64 &&& 0xFF).toUInt8
  padded := padded.set! (padded_len - 5) ((ml >>> 32).toUInt64 &&& 0xFF).toUInt8
  padded := padded.set! (padded_len - 4) ((ml >>> 24).toUInt64 &&& 0xFF).toUInt8
  padded := padded.set! (padded_len - 3) ((ml >>> 16).toUInt64 &&& 0xFF).toUInt8
  padded := padded.set! (padded_len - 2) ((ml >>> 8).toUInt64 &&& 0xFF).toUInt8
  padded := padded.set! (padded_len - 1) ((ml >>> 0).toUInt64 &&& 0xFF).toUInt8
  
  let rec (i : Nat) (st : Array UInt64) : Array UInt64 :=
    if i < padded_len / 64 then
      let chunk := Array.mkArray 16 (0:UInt64)
      let mut c' := chunk
      for j in [:16] do
        let idx := i * 64 + j * 4
        let v := (padded[idx]!.toUInt64 <<< 24) ||| (padded[idx+1]!.toUInt64 <<< 16) ||| (padded[idx+2]!.toUInt64 <<< 8) ||| padded[idx+3]!.toUInt64
        c' := c'.set! j v
      let st' := sha256_transform st c'
      rec (i + 1) st'
    else st
  termination_by (padded_len / 64) - i
  decreasing_by
    simp_wf
    apply Nat.sub_pos_of_lt
    assumption
    
  let final_state := rec 0 init
  let mut res := ByteArray.mk (List.replicate 32 0)
  for i in [:8] do
    let v := final_state[i]!
    res := res.set! (4*i) ((v >>> 24) &&& 0xFF).toUInt8
    res := res.set! (4*i+1) ((v >>> 16) &&& 0xFF).toUInt8
    res := res.set! (4*i+2) ((v >>> 8) &&& 0xFF).toUInt8
    res := res.set! (4*i+3) ((v >>> 0) &&& 0xFF).toUInt8
  res

def computeContentHash (data : ByteArray) : ByteArray :=
  let full := sha256 data
  let res := ByteArray.mk (List.replicate CONTENT_HASH_SIZE 0)
  let rec (i : Nat) (acc : ByteArray) : ByteArray :=
    if i < CONTENT_HASH_SIZE then rec (i + 1) (acc.set! i full[i]!) else acc
  termination_by CONTENT_HASH_SIZE - i
  decreasing_by
    simp_wf
    apply Nat.sub_pos_of_lt
    assumption
  rec 0 res

def computeBlockId (content_hash : ByteArray) (timestamp : Int) : ByteArray :=
  let buffer := ByteArray.mk (List.replicate (CONTENT_HASH_SIZE + 16) 0)
  let rec1 (i : Nat) (acc : ByteArray) : ByteArray :=
    if i < CONTENT_HASH_SIZE then rec1 (i + 1) (acc.set! i content_hash[i]!) else acc
  termination_by CONTENT_HASH_SIZE - i
  decreasing_by
    simp_wf
    apply Nat.sub_pos_of_lt
    assumption
  let buffer := rec1 0 buffer
  let buffer := writeI128Little buffer timestamp
  let hash_out := sha256 buffer
  let res := ByteArray.mk (List.replicate BLOCK_ID_SIZE 0)
  let rec2 (i : Nat) (acc : ByteArray) : ByteArray :=
    if i < BLOCK_ID_SIZE then rec2 (i + 1) (acc.set! i hash_out[i]!) else acc
  termination_by BLOCK_ID_SIZE - i
  decreasing_by
    simp_wf
    apply Nat.sub_pos_of_lt
    assumption
  rec2 0 res

structure ContentAddressableStorage where
  storage : StorageMap
  content_index : ContentIndex
  affinity_map : AffinityMap
  total_capacity : Nat
  used_capacity : Nat
deriving Repr

def ContentAddressableStorage.init (allocator : Allocator) (cap : Nat) : ContentAddressableStorage :=
  { storage := Std.RBMap.empty (fun a b => a < b)
    content_index := Std.RBMap.empty (fun a b => a < b)
    affinity_map := Std.RBMap.empty (fun a b => a < b)
    total_capacity := cap
    used_capacity := 0 }

def unlinkEntanglements (storage : StorageMap) (block_id : ByteArray) (entangled : BlockIdSet) : StorageMap :=
  let rec (iter : BlockIdSet) (acc : StorageMap) : StorageMap :=
    if iter.isEmpty then acc
    else
      let other_id := iter.getMin!.1
      let acc' := match acc.find? other_id with
        | some block =>
            let new_block := block.removeEntangledBlock block_id
            let final_block := if new_block.entangledCount == 0 && new_block.state == .entangled then { new_block with state := .allocated } else new_block
            acc.insert other_id final_block
        | none => acc
      rec (iter.erase other_id) acc'
  termination_by iter.size
  decreasing_by
    simp_wf
    apply Nat.sub_pos_of_lt
    apply BlockIdSet.size_erase
    simp
    intro h
    rw [h]
    contradiction
  rec entangled storage

def evictLeastUsed (self : ContentAddressableStorage) (allocator : Allocator) (required_free : Nat) : ContentAddressableStorage :=
  let entries := self.storage.fold (fun acc id block => acc ++ [(id, block.access_count, block.last_access_time, block.size, block.state == .entangled)]) []
  let compareEnt (a : ByteArray × Nat × Int × Nat × Bool) (b : ByteArray × Nat × Int × Nat × Bool) : Bool :=
    if a.5 != b.5 then !a.5 && b.5
    else if a.2 != b.2 then a.2 < b.2
    else a.3 < b.3
  let sorted := List.sort compareEnt entries
  let rec (lst : List (ByteArray × Nat × Int × Nat × Bool)) (freed : Nat) (acc : ContentAddressableStorage) : ContentAddressableStorage :=
    if required_free == 0 then acc
    else
      match lst with
      | [] => acc
      | (id, _, _, size, ent) :: rest =>
          if freed >= required_free then acc
          else
            let match_block := acc.storage.find? id
            let acc' := match match_block with
              | some block =>
                  let s' := acc.storage.erase id
                  let ci' := acc.content_index.alter (fun os => match os with | some s => if (s.erase id).isEmpty then none else some (s.erase id) | none => none) block.content_hash
                  let am' := match block.affinity_core with | some c => acc.affinity_map.alter (fun os => match os with | some s => if (s.erase id).isEmpty then none else some (s.erase id) | none => none) c | none => acc.affinity_map
                  let uc := if acc.used_capacity >= size then acc.used_capacity - size else 0
                  { acc with storage := s', content_index := ci', affinity_map := am', used_capacity := uc }
              | none => acc
            rec rest (freed + acc'.used_capacity - acc.used_capacity) acc'
  termination_by lst.length
  decreasing_by
    simp_wf
    apply Nat.sub_pos_of_lt
    simp
  rec sorted 0 self

def ContentAddressableStorage.findNearestCore (self : ContentAddressableStorage) (block_id : ByteArray) (cores : Std.RBMap Nat ProcessingCore (fun a b => a < b)) : Option Nat :=
  match self.storage.find? block_id with
  | none => none
  | some block =>
      match block.affinity_core with
      | some core =>
          match cores.find? core with
          | some cinfo => if cinfo.state != .power_gated then some core else none
          | none => none
      | none =>
          let init : Option (Nat × Float) := none
          let res := cores.fold (fun acc entry =>
              let cid := entry.key
              let cinfo := entry.val
              if cinfo.state == .power_gated then acc
              else
                let mut entangled_count : Nat := 0
                let count := match self.affinity_map.find? cid with
                  | some core_blocks =>
                      block.entangled_blocks.fold (fun c ebid =>
                        if core_blocks.contains ebid then c + 1 else c
                      ) 0
                  | none => 0
                let distance := 1.0 / (1.0 + Float.ofNat count)
                match acc with
                | none => some (cid, distance)
                | some (bid, min_dist) => if distance < min_dist then some (cid, distance) else acc
            ) init
          res.map Prod.fst

def ContentAddressableStorage.store (self : ContentAddressableStorage) (allocator : Allocator) (data : ByteArray) (preferred_core : Option Nat) (time : Int) : Except Unit ContentAddressableStorage :=
  let content_hash := computeContentHash data
  let data_size := data.size
  if data_size > self.total_capacity then throw ()
  
  match self.content_index.find? content_hash with
  | some existing_blocks =>
      let rec (iter : BlockIdSet) (found_id : Option ByteArray) (stale : List ByteArray) : Option ByteArray × List ByteArray :=
        if iter.isEmpty then (found_id, stale)
        else
          let id := iter.getMin!.1
          match self.storage.find? id with
          | some _ => (some id, stale)
          | none => rec (iter.erase id) found_id (stale ++ [id])
      termination_by iter.size
      decreasing_by
        simp_wf
        apply Nat.sub_pos_of_lt
        apply BlockIdSet.size_erase
        simp
        intro h
        rw [h]
        contradiction
      let (fid, stale_list) := rec existing_blocks none []
      let new_content_index := stale_list.foldl (fun acc sid => acc.alter (fun s => match s with | some set => some (set.erase sid) | none => none) content_hash) self.content_index
      let self' := { self with content_index := new_content_index }
      match fid with
      | some id =>
          let block := self'.storage.find? id |>.get!
          let updated_block := block.updateAccessTime time
          let new_storage := self'.storage.insert id updated_block
          pure { self' with storage := new_storage }
      | none =>
          if self'.used_capacity + data_size > self'.total_capacity then
             let need := (self'.used_capacity + data_size) - self'.total_capacity
             let self'' := evictLeastUsed self' allocator need
             if self''.used_capacity + data_size > self''.total_capacity then throw ()
             else
                let timestamp := time
                let block_id := computeBlockId content_hash timestamp
                let block := MemoryBlock.init allocator block_id content_hash data preferred_core time
                let new_storage := self''.storage.insert block_id block
                let new_content_index := self''.content_index.alter (fun s => match s with | some set => some (set.insert block_id) | none => some (Std.RBSet.empty (fun a b => a < b)).insert block_id) content_hash
                let new_affinity_map := match preferred_core with | some core_id => self''.affinity_map.alter (fun s => match s with | some set => some (set.insert block_id) | none => some (Std.RBSet.empty (fun a b => a < b)).insert block_id) core_id | none => self''.affinity_map
                pure { storage := new_storage, content_index := new_content_index, affinity_map := new_affinity_map, total_capacity := self''.total_capacity, used_capacity := self''.used_capacity + data_size }
          else
             let timestamp := time
             let block_id := computeBlockId content_hash timestamp
             let block := MemoryBlock.init allocator block_id content_hash data preferred_core time
             let new_storage := self'.storage.insert block_id block
             let new_content_index := self'.content_index.alter (fun s => match s with | some set => some (set.insert block_id) | none => some (Std.RBSet.empty (fun a b => a < b)).insert block_id) content_hash
             let new_affinity_map := match preferred_core with | some core_id => self'.affinity_map.alter (fun s => match s with | some set => some (set.insert block_id) | none => some (Std.RBSet.empty (fun a b => a < b)).insert block_id) core_id | none => self'.affinity_map
             pure { storage := new_storage, content_index := new_content_index, affinity_map := new_affinity_map, total_capacity := self'.total_capacity, used_capacity := self'.used_capacity + data_size }
  | none =>
      if self.used_capacity + data_size > self.total_capacity then
         let need := (self.used_capacity + data_size) - self.total_capacity
         let self' := evictLeastUsed self allocator need
         if self'.used_capacity + data_size > self'.total_capacity then throw ()
         else
            let timestamp := time
            let block_id := computeBlockId content_hash timestamp
            let block := MemoryBlock.init allocator block_id content_hash data preferred_core time
            let new_storage := self'.storage.insert block_id block
            let new_content_index := self'.content_index.alter (fun s => match s with | some set => some (set.insert block_id) | none => some (Std.RBSet.empty (fun a b => a < b)).insert block_id) content_hash
            let new_affinity_map := match preferred_core with | some core_id => self'.affinity_map.alter (fun s => match s with | some set => some (set.insert block_id) | none => some (Std.RBSet.empty (fun a b => a < b)).insert block_id) core_id | none => self'.affinity_map
            pure { storage := new_storage, content_index := new_content_index, affinity_map := new_affinity_map, total_capacity := self'.total_capacity, used_capacity := self'.used_capacity + data_size }
      else
         let timestamp := time
         let block_id := computeBlockId content_hash timestamp
         let block := MemoryBlock.init allocator block_id content_hash data preferred_core time
         let new_storage := self.storage.insert block_id block

def DynamicTaskScheduler.submitTask (self : DynamicTaskScheduler) (allocator : Allocator) (priority : Int) (deps : List ByteArray) (est : Nat) (time : Int) : DynamicTaskScheduler :=
  let task_id := self.generateTaskId time
  let task := TaskDescriptor.init allocator task_id priority est
  let task_with_deps := deps.foldl (fun t d => t.addDependency allocator d) task
  let new_pending := insertSorted self.pending_tasks task_with_deps compareTasks
  { self with pending_tasks := new_pending, task_counter := self.task_counter + 1 }

def DynamicTaskScheduler.scheduleTask (self : DynamicTaskScheduler) (cores : Std.RBMap Nat ProcessingCore (fun a b => a < b))
    (storage : ContentAddressableStorage) (time : Int) : DynamicTaskScheduler × Option (ByteArray × Nat) :=
  match self.pending_tasks with
  | [] => (self, none)
  | task :: rest =>
      let scores := cores.fold (fun acc cid core =>
        if core.state == .power_gated then acc
        else
          let mut score : Float := 0.0
          for dep in task.data_dependencies do
            if storage.storage.contains dep then
              let nearest := storage.findNearestCore dep cores
              match nearest with
              | some nearest_core =>
                  if nearest_core == cid then score := score + 10.0 else score := score + 1.0
              | none => score := score + 1.0
          let workload := if core.cycles_active + core.cycles_idle == 0 then 0.0 else Float.ofNat core.cycles_active / Float.ofNat (core.cycles_active + core.cycles_idle)
          score := score + (1.0 - workload) * 5.0
          acc.insert cid score
      ) (Std.RBMap.empty (fun a b => a < b))
      
      if scores.isEmpty then (self, none)
      else
        let best := scores.fold (fun acc entry => if acc.2 < entry.val then (entry.key, entry.val) else acc) (0, 0.0) scores
        let core_id := best.1
        let updated_task := { task with assigned_core := some core_id, start_time := time }
        let new_active := self.active_tasks.insert task.task_id updated_task
        ({ self with pending_tasks := rest, active_tasks := new_active }, some (task.task_id, core_id))

  match self.active_tasks.remove? task_id with
  | none => self
  | some (_, task) =>
      let finished := { task with completion_status := true, end_time := time }
      { self with active_tasks := self.active_tasks.erase task_id, completed_tasks := finished :: self.completed_tasks }

  { self with access_patterns := new_patterns }

  tasks.foldl (fun acc task =>
      let deps := task.data_dependencies
      let recDeps (i : Nat) (innerAcc : DataFlowAnalyzer) : DataFlowAnalyzer :=
        if i < deps.length - 1 then
          let dep1 := deps.get! i
          let recJ (j : Nat) (jAcc : DataFlowAnalyzer) : DataFlowAnalyzer :=
            if j < deps.length - (i + 1) then
              let dep2 := deps.get! (i + 1 + j)
              let fg1 := jAcc.flow_graph.alter (fun s => match s with | some set => some (set.insert dep2) | none => some (Std.RBSet.empty (fun a b => a < b)).insert dep2) dep1
              let fg2 := fg1.alter (fun s => match s with | some set => some (set.insert dep1) | none => some (Std.RBSet.empty (fun a b => a < b)).insert dep1) dep2

              let fw := fg2.flow_weights.alter (fun w => match w with | some val => some (val + 1.0) | none => some 1.0) key
              { jAcc with flow_graph := fg1, flow_weights := fw }
            else jAcc
          recJ 0 innerAcc
        else innerAcc
      recDeps 0 acc
    ) self tasks

  | none => none

def ChaosCoreKernel.createTask (self : ChaosCoreKernel) (priority : Int) (deps : List ByteArray) (est : Nat) (time : Int) : ChaosCoreKernel × ByteArray :=
  let new_sched := self.scheduler.submitTask self.allocator priority deps est time
  let id := new_sched.generateTaskId time
  let tmp_task := TaskDescriptor.init self.allocator id priority est
  let tmp_task_deps := deps.foldl (fun t d => t.addDependency self.allocator d) tmp_task
  let new_analyzer := self.flow_analyzer.buildFlowGraph self.allocator [tmp_task_deps]
  ({ self with scheduler := new_sched, flow_analyzer := new_analyzer }, id)

  let new_sched := self.scheduler.completeTask self.allocator task_id time
  let existed := self.scheduler.active_tasks.contains task_id
  (existed, { self with scheduler := new_sched })

  { self with storage := self.storage.entangleBlocks block_id1 block_id2 }

def ChaosCoreKernel.executeCycle (self : ChaosCoreKernel) (time : Int) : ChaosCoreKernel :=
  let cycle := self.cycle_count + 1
  let (new_sched, scheduled_info) := self.scheduler.scheduleTask self.cores self.storage time
  let new_analyzer := match scheduled_info with
    | some (tid, cid) =>
        let task := new_sched.active_tasks.find? tid |>.get!
        task.data_dependencies.foldl (fun acc dep => acc.recordAccess self.allocator dep cid time) self.flow_analyzer
    | none => self.flow_analyzer
  
  let new_cores := self.cores.fold (fun acc cid core =>
      let is_active := match scheduled_info with | some (_, scid) => scid == cid | none => false
      acc.insert cid (core.tick is_active)
    ) self.cores self.cores
  
  { self with scheduler := new_sched, flow_analyzer := new_analyzer, cores := new_cores, cycle_count := cycle }

  nodes : Std.RBMap String Node (fun a b => a < b)

def ChaosCoreKernel.executeGraphOnKernel (self : ChaosCoreKernel) (graph : SelfSimilarRelationalGraph) (time : Int) : ChaosCoreKernel :=
  let rec_nodes (iter : List (String × Node)) (acc : ChaosCoreKernel × Std.RBMap String ByteArray (fun a b => a < b)) : ChaosCoreKernel × Std.RBMap String ByteArray (fun a b => a < b) :=
    match iter with
    | [] => acc
    | (id, node) :: rest =>

  termination_by iter.length
  decreasing_by
    simp_wf
    apply Nat.sub_pos_of_lt
    simp

  let (k', node_to_block) := rec_nodes graph.nodes.toList (self, Std.RBMap.empty (fun a b => a < b))

  let rec_edges (iter : List (Edge × EdgeQuality)) (acc : ChaosCoreKernel) : ChaosCoreKernel :=
    match iter with
    | [] => acc
    | (edge, _) :: rest =>
        let source_block := node_to_block.find? edge.source
        let target_block := node_to_block.find? edge.target
        match source_block, target_block with
        | some sb, some tb =>
            let k'' := acc.entangleData sb tb
            rec_edges rest k''
        | _, _ => rec_edges rest acc
  termination_by iter.length
  decreasing_by
    simp_wf
    apply Nat.sub_pos_of_lt
    simp
  rec_edges graph.edges.toList k'

def sha256_ch (x y z : UInt64) : UInt64 := (x &&& y) ^^^ (~x &&& z)
def sha256_maj (x y z : UInt64) : UInt64 := (x &&& y) ^^^ (x &&& z) ^^^ (y &&& z)
def sha256_sigma0 (x : UInt64) : UInt64 := sha256_rotateRight x 2 ^^^ sha256_rotateRight x 13 ^^^ sha256_rotateRight x 22
def sha256_sigma1 (x : UInt64) : UInt64 := sha256_rotateRight x 6 ^^^ sha256_rotateRight x 11 ^^^ sha256_rotateRight x 25
def sha256_gamma0 (x : UInt64) : UInt64 := sha256_rotateRight x 7 ^^^ sha256_rotateRight x 18 ^^^ (x >>> 3)
def sha256_gamma1 (x : UInt64) : UInt64 := sha256_rotateRight x 17 ^^^ sha256_rotateRight x 19 ^^^ (x >>> 10)

def sha256_prepare_w (chunk : Array UInt64) : Array UInt64 :=
  let mut w := Array.mkArray 64 (0:UInt64)
  for i in [:16] do
    w := w.set! i chunk[i]!
  let mut j := 16
  while j < 64 do
    let s0 := sha256_gamma0 (w[j-3]!)
    let s1 := sha256_gamma1 (w[j-8]!)
    let val := (w[j-16]! + s0 + w[j-7]! + s1).toUInt64
    w := w.set! j val
    j := j + 1
  termination_by 64 - j
  decreasing_by
    simp_wf
    apply Nat.sub_pos_of_lt
    assumption
  w

def sha256_transform (state : Array UInt64) (chunk : Array UInt64) : Array UInt64 :=
  let w := sha256_prepare_w chunk
  let rec (i : Nat) (a b c d e f g h : UInt64) : UInt64 × UInt64 × UInt64 × UInt64 × UInt64 × UInt64 × UInt64 × UInt64 :=
    if i < 64 then
      let s1 := sha256_sigma1 e
      let ch := sha256_ch e f g
      let temp1 := h + s1 + ch + (sha256_k i).toUInt64 + w[i]!
      let s0 := sha256_sigma0 a
      let maj := sha256_maj a b c
      let temp2 := s0 + maj
      rec (i + 1) (temp1 + temp2) a b c d (d + temp1) e f
    else (a, b, c, d, e, f, g, h)
  termination_by 64 - i
  decreasing_by
    simp_wf
    apply Nat.sub_pos_of_lt
    assumption
  let (na, nb, nc, nd, ne, nf, ng, nh) := rec 0 state[0]! state[1]! state[2]! state[3]! state[4]! state[5]! state[6]! state[7]!
  #[na + state[0]!, nb + state[1]!, nc + state[2]!, nd + state[3]!, ne + state[4]!, nf + state[5]!, ng + state[6]!, nh + state[7]!]

def sha256 (data : ByteArray) : ByteArray :=
  let init := #[0x6a09e667, 0xbb67ae85, 0x3c6ef372, 0xa54ff53a, 0x510e527f, 0x9b05688c, 0x1f83d9ab, 0x5be0cd19].map (λ x => x.toUInt64)
  let ml := data.size * 8
  let padded_len := ((data.size + 8 + 64) / 64) * 64
  let mut padded := Array.mkArray padded_len (0:UInt8)
  for i in [:data.size] do
    padded := padded.set! i data[i]!
  padded := padded.set! data.size 0x80
  padded := padded.set! (padded_len - 8) ((ml >>> 56).toUInt64 &&& 0xFF).toUInt8
  padded := padded.set! (padded_len - 7) ((ml >>> 48).toUInt64 &&& 0xFF).toUInt8
  padded := padded.set! (padded_len - 6) ((ml >>> 40).toUInt64 &&& 0xFF).toUInt8
  padded := padded.set! (padded_len - 5) ((ml >>> 32).toUInt64 &&& 0xFF).toUInt8
  padded := padded.set! (padded_len - 4) ((ml >>> 24).toUInt64 &&& 0xFF).toUInt8
  padded := padded.set! (padded_len - 3) ((ml >>> 16).toUInt64 &&& 0xFF).toUInt8
  padded := padded.set! (padded_len - 2) ((ml >>> 8).toUInt64 &&& 0xFF).toUInt8
  padded := padded.set! (padded_len - 1) ((ml >>> 0).toUInt64 &&& 0xFF).toUInt8
  
  let rec (i : Nat) (st : Array UInt64) : Array UInt64 :=
    if i < padded_len / 64 then
      let chunk := Array.mkArray 16 (0:UInt64)
      let mut c' := chunk
      for j in [:16] do
        let idx := i * 64 + j * 4
        let v := (padded[idx]!.toUInt64 <<< 24) ||| (padded[idx+1]!.toUInt64 <<< 16) ||| (padded[idx+2]!.toUInt64 <<< 8) ||| padded[idx+3]!.toUInt64
        c' := c'.set! j v
      let st' := sha256_transform st c'
      rec (i + 1) st'
    else st
  termination_by (padded_len / 64) - i
  decreasing_by
    simp_wf
    apply Nat.sub_pos_of_lt
    assumption
    
  let final_state := rec 0 init
  let mut res := ByteArray.mk (List.replicate 32 0)
  for i in [:8] do
    let v := final_state[i]!
    res := res.set! (4*i) ((v >>> 24) &&& 0xFF).toUInt8
    res := res.set! (4*i+1) ((v >>> 16) &&& 0xFF).toUInt8
    res := res.set! (4*i+2) ((v >>> 8) &&& 0xFF).toUInt8
    res := res.set! (4*i+3) ((v >>> 0) &&& 0xFF).toUInt8
  res

def computeContentHash (data : ByteArray) : ByteArray :=
  let full := sha256 data
  let res := ByteArray.mk (List.replicate CONTENT_HASH_SIZE 0)
  let rec (i : Nat) (acc : ByteArray) : ByteArray :=
    if i < CONTENT_HASH_SIZE then rec (i + 1) (acc.set! i full[i]!) else acc
  termination_by CONTENT_HASH_SIZE - i
  decreasing_by
    simp_wf
    apply Nat.sub_pos_of_lt
    assumption
  rec 0 res

def computeBlockId (content_hash : ByteArray) (timestamp : Int) : ByteArray :=
  let buffer := ByteArray.mk (List.replicate (CONTENT_HASH_SIZE + 16) 0)
  let rec1 (i : Nat) (acc : ByteArray) : ByteArray :=
    if i < CONTENT_HASH_SIZE then rec1 (i + 1) (acc.set! i content_hash[i]!) else acc
  termination_by CONTENT_HASH_SIZE - i
  decreasing_by
    simp_wf
    apply Nat.sub_pos_of_lt
    assumption
  let buffer := rec1 0 buffer
  let buffer := writeI128Little buffer timestamp
  let hash_out := sha256 buffer
  let res := ByteArray.mk (List.replicate BLOCK_ID_SIZE 0)
  let rec2 (i : Nat) (acc : ByteArray) : ByteArray :=
    if i < BLOCK_ID_SIZE then rec2 (i + 1) (acc.set! i hash_out[i]!) else acc
  termination_by BLOCK_ID_SIZE - i
  decreasing_by
    simp_wf
    apply Nat.sub_pos_of_lt
    assumption
  rec2 0 res

structure ContentAddressableStorage where
  storage : StorageMap
  content_index : ContentIndex
  affinity_map : AffinityMap
  total_capacity : Nat
  used_capacity : Nat
deriving Repr

def ContentAddressableStorage.init (allocator : Allocator) (cap : Nat) : ContentAddressableStorage :=
  { storage := Std.RBMap.empty (fun a b => a < b)
    content_index := Std.RBMap.empty (fun a b => a < b)
    affinity_map := Std.RBMap.empty (fun a b => a < b)
    total_capacity := cap
    used_capacity := 0 }

def unlinkEntanglements (storage : StorageMap) (block_id : ByteArray) (entangled : BlockIdSet) : StorageMap :=
  let rec (iter : BlockIdSet) (acc : StorageMap) : StorageMap :=
    if iter.isEmpty then acc
    else
      let other_id := iter.getMin!.1
      let acc' := match acc.find? other_id with
        | some block =>
            let new_block := block.removeEntangledBlock block_id
            let final_block := if new_block.entangledCount == 0 && new_block.state == .entangled then { new_block with state := .allocated } else new_block
            acc.insert other_id final_block
        | none => acc
      rec (iter.erase other_id) acc'
  termination_by iter.size
  decreasing_by
    simp_wf
    apply Nat.sub_pos_of_lt
    apply BlockIdSet.size_erase
    simp
    intro h
    rw [h]
    contradiction
  rec entangled storage

def evictLeastUsed (self : ContentAddressableStorage) (allocator : Allocator) (required_free : Nat) : ContentAddressableStorage :=
  let entries := self.storage.fold (fun acc id block => acc ++ [(id, block.access_count, block.last_access_time, block.size, block.state == .entangled)]) []
  let compareEnt (a : ByteArray × Nat × Int × Nat × Bool) (b : ByteArray × Nat × Int × Nat × Bool) : Bool :=
    if a.5 != b.5 then !a.5 && b.5
    else if a.2 != b.2 then a.2 < b.2
    else a.3 < b.3
  let sorted := List.sort compareEnt entries
  let rec (lst : List (ByteArray × Nat × Int × Nat × Bool)) (freed : Nat) (acc : ContentAddressableStorage) : ContentAddressableStorage :=
    if required_free == 0 then acc
    else
      match lst with
      | [] => acc
      | (id, _, _, size, ent) :: rest =>
          if freed >= required_free then acc
          else
            let match_block := acc.storage.find? id
            let acc' := match match_block with
              | some block =>
                  let s' := acc.storage.erase id
                  let ci' := acc.content_index.alter (fun os => match os with | some s => if (s.erase id).isEmpty then none else some (s.erase id) | none => none) block.content_hash
                  let am' := match block.affinity_core with | some c => acc.affinity_map.alter (fun os => match os with | some s => if (s.erase id).isEmpty then none else some (s.erase id) | none => none) c | none => acc.affinity_map
                  let uc := if acc.used_capacity >= size then acc.used_capacity - size else 0
                  { acc with storage := s', content_index := ci', affinity_map := am', used_capacity := uc }
              | none => acc
            rec rest (freed + acc'.used_capacity - acc.used_capacity) acc'
  termination_by lst.length
  decreasing_by
    simp_wf
    apply Nat.sub_pos_of_lt
    simp
  rec sorted 0 self

def ContentAddressableStorage.findNearestCore (self : ContentAddressableStorage) (block_id : ByteArray) (cores : Std.RBMap Nat ProcessingCore (fun a b => a < b)) : Option Nat :=
  match self.storage.find? block_id with
  | none => none
  | some block =>
      match block.affinity_core with
      | some core =>
          match cores.find? core with
          | some cinfo => if cinfo.state != .power_gated then some core else none
          | none => none
      | none =>
          let init : Option (Nat × Float) := none
          let res := cores.fold (fun acc entry =>
              let cid := entry.key
              let cinfo := entry.val
              if cinfo.state == .power_gated then acc
              else
                let mut entangled_count : Nat := 0
                let count := match self.affinity_map.find? cid with
                  | some core_blocks =>
                      block.entangled_blocks.fold (fun c ebid =>
                        if core_blocks.contains ebid then c + 1 else c
                      ) 0
                  | none => 0
                let distance := 1.0 / (1.0 + Float.ofNat count)
                match acc with
                | none => some (cid, distance)
                | some (bid, min_dist) => if distance < min_dist then some (cid, distance) else acc
            ) init
          res.map Prod.fst

def ContentAddressableStorage.store (self : ContentAddressableStorage) (allocator : Allocator) (data : ByteArray) (preferred_core : Option Nat) (time : Int) : Except Unit ContentAddressableStorage :=
  let content_hash := computeContentHash data
  let data_size := data.size
  if data_size > self.total_capacity then throw ()
  
  match self.content_index.find? content_hash with
  | some existing_blocks =>
      let rec (iter : BlockIdSet) (found_id : Option ByteArray) (stale : List ByteArray) : Option ByteArray × List ByteArray :=
        if iter.isEmpty then (found_id, stale)
        else
          let id := iter.getMin!.1
          match self.storage.find? id with
          | some _ => (some id, stale)
          | none => rec (iter.erase id) found_id (stale ++ [id])
      termination_by iter.size
      decreasing_by
        simp_wf
        apply Nat.sub_pos_of_lt
        apply BlockIdSet.size_erase
        simp
        intro h
        rw [h]
        contradiction
      let (fid, stale_list) := rec existing_blocks none []
      let new_content_index := stale_list.foldl (fun acc sid => acc.alter (fun s => match s with | some set => some (set.erase sid) | none => none) content_hash) self.content_index
      let self' := { self with content_index := new_content_index }
      match fid with
      | some id =>
          let block := self'.storage.find? id |>.get!
          let updated_block := block.updateAccessTime time
          let new_storage := self'.storage.insert id updated_block
          pure { self' with storage := new_storage }
      | none =>
          if self'.used_capacity + data_size > self'.total_capacity then
             let need := (self'.used_capacity + data_size) - self'.total_capacity
             let self'' := evictLeastUsed self' allocator need
             if self''.used_capacity + data_size > self''.total_capacity then throw ()
             else
                let timestamp := time
                let block_id := computeBlockId content_hash timestamp
                let block := MemoryBlock.init allocator block_id content_hash data preferred_core time
                let new_storage := self''.storage.insert block_id block
                let new_content_index := self''.content_index.alter (fun s => match s with | some set => some (set.insert block_id) | none => some (Std.RBSet.empty (fun a b => a < b)).insert block_id) content_hash
                let new_affinity_map := match preferred_core with | some core_id => self''.affinity_map.alter (fun s => match s with | some set => some (set.insert block_id) | none => some (Std.RBSet.empty (fun a b => a < b)).insert block_id) core_id | none => self''.affinity_map
                pure { storage := new_storage, content_index := new_content_index, affinity_map := new_affinity_map, total_capacity := self''.total_capacity, used_capacity := self''.used_capacity + data_size }
          else
             let timestamp := time
             let block_id := computeBlockId content_hash timestamp
             let block := MemoryBlock.init allocator block_id content_hash data preferred_core time
             let new_storage := self'.storage.insert block_id block
             let new_content_index := self'.content_index.alter (fun s => match s with | some set => some (set.insert block_id) | none => some (Std.RBSet.empty (fun a b => a < b)).insert block_id) content_hash
             let new_affinity_map := match preferred_core with | some core_id => self'.affinity_map.alter (fun s => match s with | some set => some (set.insert block_id) | none => some (Std.RBSet.empty (fun a b => a < b)).insert block_id) core_id | none => self'.affinity_map
             pure { storage := new_storage, content_index := new_content_index, affinity_map := new_affinity_map, total_capacity := self'.total_capacity, used_capacity := self'.used_capacity + data_size }
  | none =>
      if self.used_capacity + data_size > self.total_capacity then
         let need := (self.used_capacity + data_size) - self.total_capacity
         let self' := evictLeastUsed self allocator need
         if self'.used_capacity + data_size > self'.total_capacity then throw ()
         else
            let timestamp := time
            let block_id := computeBlockId content_hash timestamp
            let block := MemoryBlock.init allocator block_id content_hash data preferred_core time
            let new_storage := self'.storage.insert block_id block
            let new_content_index := self'.content_index.alter (fun s => match s with | some set => some (set.insert block_id) | none => some (Std.RBSet.empty (fun a b => a < b)).insert block_id) content_hash
            let new_affinity_map := match preferred_core with | some core_id => self'.affinity_map.alter (fun s => match s with | some set => some (set.insert block_id) | none => some (Std.RBSet.empty (fun a b => a < b)).insert block_id) core_id | none => self'.affinity_map
            pure { storage := new_storage, content_index := new_content_index, affinity_map := new_affinity_map, total_capacity := self'.total_capacity, used_capacity := self'.used_capacity + data_size }
      else
         let timestamp := time
         let block_id := computeBlockId content_hash timestamp
         let block := MemoryBlock.init allocator block_id content_hash data preferred_core time
         let new_storage := self.storage.insert block_id block
         let new_content_index := self.content_index.alter (fun s => match s with | some set => some (set.insert block_id) | none => some (Std.RBSet.empty (fun a b => a < b)).insert block_id) content_hash
         let new_affinity_map := match preferred_core with | some core_id => self.affinity_map.alter (fun s => match s with | some set => some (set.insert block_id) | none => some (Std.RBSet.empty (fun a b => a < b)).insert block_id) core_id | none => self.affinity_map
         pure { storage := new_storage, content_index := new_content_index, affinity_map := new_affinity_map, total_capacity := self.total_capacity, used_capacity := self.used_capacity + data_size }

def ContentAddressableStorage.retrieve (self : ContentAddressableStorage) (block_id : ByteArray) (time : Int) : Option (ByteArray × ContentAddressableStorage) :=
  match self.storage.find? block_id with
  | some block =>
      let updated_block := block.updateAccessTime time
      let new_storage := self.storage.insert block_id updated_block
      some (block.data, { self with storage := new_storage })
  | none => none

def ContentAddressableStorage.entangleBlocks (self : ContentAddressableStorage) (block_id1 : ByteArray) (block_id2 : ByteArray) : ContentAddressableStorage :=
  let block1 := self.storage.find? block_id1
  let block2 := self.storage.find? block_id2
  match block1, block2 with
  | some b1, some b2 =>
      if block_id1 == block_id2 then self
      else
        let nb1 := b1.addEntangledBlock block_id2
        let nb2 := b2.addEntangledBlock block_id1
        let sb1 := { nb1 with state := .entangled }
        let sb2 := { nb2 with state := .entangled }
        let s' := self.storage.insert block_id1 sb1 |>.insert block_id2 sb2
        { self with storage := s' }
  | _, _ => self

def ContentAddressableStorage.migrateBlock (self : ContentAddressableStorage) (block_id : ByteArray) (target_core : Nat) : ContentAddressableStorage :=
  match self.storage.find? block_id with
  | some block =>
      let am' := match block.affinity_core with
        | some old_core =>
            self.affinity_map.alter (fun s => match s with | some set => if (set.erase block_id).isEmpty then none else some (set.erase block_id) | none => none) old_core
        | none => self.affinity_map
      let mb := { block with state := .migrating, affinity_core := some target_core }
      let am'' := am'.alter (fun s => match s with | some set => some (set.insert block_id) | none => some (Std.RBSet.empty (fun a b => a < b)).insert block_id) target_core
      let fb := { mb with state := .allocated }
      let s' := self.storage.insert block_id fb
      { self with storage := s', affinity_map := am'' }
  | none => self

structure TaskDescriptor where
  task_id : ByteArray
  priority : Int
  data_dependencies : List ByteArray
  estimated_cycles : Nat
  assigned_core : Option Nat
  completion_status : Bool
  start_time : Int
  end_time : Int
deriving Repr

def TaskDescriptor.init (allocator : Allocator) (task_id : ByteArray) (priority : Int) (est : Nat) : TaskDescriptor :=
  { task_id := task_id
    priority := priority
    data_dependencies := []
    estimated_cycles := est
    assigned_core := none
    completion_status := false
    start_time := 0
    end_time := 0 }

def TaskDescriptor.addDependency (self : TaskDescriptor) (allocator : Allocator) (dep : ByteArray) : TaskDescriptor :=
  { self with data_dependencies := self.data_dependencies ++ [dep] }

def TaskDescriptor.getDuration (self : TaskDescriptor) : Int :=
  if self.completion_status && self.end_time > self.start_time then self.end_time - self.start_time else 0

def compareTasks (a b : TaskDescriptor) : Bool :=
  a.priority > b.priority || (a.priority == b.priority && compare a.task_id b.task_id == .lt)

structure DynamicTaskScheduler where
  pending_tasks : List TaskDescriptor
  active_tasks : Std.RBMap ByteArray TaskDescriptor (fun a b => a < b)
  completed_tasks : List TaskDescriptor
  task_counter : Nat
deriving Repr

def DynamicTaskScheduler.init (allocator : Allocator) : DynamicTaskScheduler :=
  { pending_tasks := []
    active_tasks := Std.RBMap.empty (fun a b => a < b)
    completed_tasks := []
    task_counter := 0 }

def DynamicTaskScheduler.generateTaskId (self : DynamicTaskScheduler) (time : Int) : ByteArray :=
  let buffer := ByteArray.mk (List.replicate 24 0)
  let b1 := writeU64Little buffer self.task_counter
  let b2 := writeI128Little b1 time
  sha256 b2

def DynamicTaskScheduler.submitTask (self : DynamicTaskScheduler) (allocator : Allocator) (priority : Int) (deps : List ByteArray) (est : Nat) (time : Int) : DynamicTaskScheduler :=
  let task_id := self.generateTaskId time
  let task := TaskDescriptor.init allocator task_id priority est
  let task_with_deps := deps.foldl (fun t d => t.addDependency allocator d) task
  let new_pending := insertSorted self.pending_tasks task_with_deps compareTasks
  { self with pending_tasks := new_pending, task_counter := self.task_counter + 1 }

def DynamicTaskScheduler.scheduleTask (self : DynamicTaskScheduler) (cores : Std.RBMap Nat ProcessingCore (fun a b => a < b))
    (storage : ContentAddressableStorage) (time : Int) : DynamicTaskScheduler × Option (ByteArray × Nat) :=
  match self.pending_tasks with
  | [] => (self, none)
  | task :: rest =>
      let scores := cores.fold (fun acc cid core =>
        if core.state == .power_gated then acc
        else
          let mut score : Float := 0.0
          for dep in task.data_dependencies do
            if storage.storage.contains dep then
              let nearest := storage.findNearestCore dep cores
              match nearest with
              | some nearest_core =>
                  if nearest_core == cid then score := score + 10.0 else score := score + 1.0
              | none => score := score + 1.0
          let workload := if core.cycles_active + core.cycles_idle == 0 then 0.0 else Float.ofNat core.cycles_active / Float.ofNat (core.cycles_active + core.cycles_idle)
          score := score + (1.0 - workload) * 5.0
          acc.insert cid score
      ) (Std.RBMap.empty (fun a b => a < b))
      
      if scores.isEmpty then (self, none)
      else
        let best := scores.fold (fun acc entry => if acc.2 < entry.val then (entry.key, entry.val) else acc) (0, 0.0) scores
        let core_id := best.1
        let updated_task := { task with assigned_core := some core_id, start_time := time }
        let new_active := self.active_tasks.insert task.task_id updated_task
        ({ self with pending_tasks := rest, active_tasks := new_active }, some (task.task_id, core_id))

def DynamicTaskScheduler.completeTask (self : DynamicTaskScheduler) (allocator : Allocator) (task_id : ByteArray) (time : Int) : DynamicTaskScheduler :=
  match self.active_tasks.remove? task_id with
  | none => self
  | some (_, task) =>
      let finished := { task with completion_status := true, end_time := time }
      { self with active_tasks := self.active_tasks.erase task_id, completed_tasks := finished :: self.completed_tasks }

inductive CoreState
| idle
| active
| power_gated
| stalled
deriving Repr, BEq

structure ProcessingCore where
  core_id : Nat
  state : CoreState
  cycles_active : Nat
  cycles_idle : Nat
deriving Repr

def ProcessingCore.init (id : Nat) : ProcessingCore :=
  { core_id := id, state := .idle, cycles_active := 0, cycles_idle := 0 }

def ProcessingCore.tick (self : ProcessingCore) (is_active : Bool) : ProcessingCore :=
  if is_active then
    { self with cycles_active := self.cycles_active + 1, state := .active }
  else
    { self with cycles_idle := self.cycles_idle + 1, state := if self.state == .power_gated then .power_gated else .idle }

def ProcessingCore.getWorkload (self : ProcessingCore) : Float :=
  let total := self.cycles_active + self.cycles_idle
  if total == 0 then 0.0 else Float.ofNat self.cycles_active / Float.ofNat total

structure FlowEdgeKey where
  source : ByteArray
  target : ByteArray
deriving Repr, BEq

structure DataFlowAnalyzer where
  flow_graph : Std.RBMap ByteArray BlockIdSet (fun a b => a < b)
  flow_weights : Std.RBMap FlowEdgeKey Float (fun a b => compare a.source b.source <>.then (compare a.target b.target) = Ordering.lt)
  access_patterns : Std.RBMap ByteArray (List AccessRecord) (fun a b => a < b)
deriving Repr

def DataFlowAnalyzer.init (allocator : Allocator) : DataFlowAnalyzer :=
  { flow_graph := Std.RBMap.empty (fun a b => a < b)
    flow_weights := Std.RBMap.empty (fun a b => compare a.source b.source <>.then (compare a.target b.target) = Ordering.lt)
    access_patterns := Std.RBMap.empty (fun a b => a < b) }

def DataFlowAnalyzer.recordAccess (self : DataFlowAnalyzer) (allocator : Allocator) (block_id : ByteArray) (core_id : Nat) (time : Int) : DataFlowAnalyzer :=
  let rec := AccessRecord.mk time core_id
  let new_patterns := self.access_patterns.alter (fun l => match l with | some list => some (rec :: list) | none => some [rec]) block_id
  { self with access_patterns := new_patterns }

def DataFlowAnalyzer.buildFlowGraph (self : DataFlowAnalyzer) (allocator : Allocator) (tasks : List TaskDescriptor) : DataFlowAnalyzer :=
  tasks.foldl (fun acc task =>
      let deps := task.data_dependencies
      let recDeps (i : Nat) (innerAcc : DataFlowAnalyzer) : DataFlowAnalyzer :=
        if i < deps.length - 1 then
          let dep1 := deps.get! i
          let recJ (j : Nat) (jAcc : DataFlowAnalyzer) : DataFlowAnalyzer :=
            if j < deps.length - (i + 1) then
              let dep2 := deps.get! (i + 1 + j)
              let fg1 := jAcc.flow_graph.alter (fun s => match s with | some set => some (set.insert dep2) | none => some (Std.RBSet.empty (fun a b => a < b)).insert dep2) dep1
              let fg2 := fg1.alter (fun s => match s with | some set => some (set.insert dep1) | none => some (Std.RBSet.empty (fun a b => a < b)).insert dep1) dep2
              let key := if compare dep1 dep2 == .lt then { source := dep1, target := dep2 } else { source := dep2, target := dep1 }
              let fw := fg2.flow_weights.alter (fun w => match w with | some val => some (val + 1.0) | none => some 1.0) key
              { jAcc with flow_graph := fg1, flow_weights := fw }
            else jAcc
          recJ 0 innerAcc
        else innerAcc
      recDeps 0 acc
    ) self tasks

structure ChaosCoreKernel where
  storage : ContentAddressableStorage
  scheduler : DynamicTaskScheduler
  flow_analyzer : DataFlowAnalyzer
  cores : Std.RBMap Nat ProcessingCore (fun a b => a < b)
  cycle_count : Nat
  migration_count : Nat
  allocator : Allocator
deriving Repr

def ChaosCoreKernel.init (allocator : Allocator) : ChaosCoreKernel :=
  { storage := ContentAddressableStorage.init allocator DEFAULT_BLOCK_SIZE
    scheduler := DynamicTaskScheduler.init allocator
    flow_analyzer := DataFlowAnalyzer.init allocator
    cores := Std.RBMap.empty (fun a b => a < b)
    cycle_count := 0
    migration_count := 0
    allocator := allocator }

def ChaosCoreKernel.addCore (self : ChaosCoreKernel) (core_id : Nat) : ChaosCoreKernel :=
  { self with cores := self.cores.insert core_id (ProcessingCore.init core_id) }

def ChaosCoreKernel.removeCore (self : ChaosCoreKernel) (core_id : Nat) : ChaosCoreKernel :=
  { self with cores := self.cores.erase core_id }

def ChaosCoreKernel.setCoreState (self : ChaosCoreKernel) (core_id : Nat) (state : CoreState) : ChaosCoreKernel :=
  match self.cores.find? core_id with
  | some core => { self with cores := self.cores.insert core_id { core with state := state } }
  | none => self

def ChaosCoreKernel.allocateMemory (self : ChaosCoreKernel) (data : ByteArray) (preferred_core : Option Nat) (time : Int) : Except Unit (ChaosCoreKernel × ByteArray) :=
  match self.storage.store self.allocator data preferred_core time with
  | Except.error e => Except.error e
  | Except.ok new_storage =>
      let block_id := computeBlockId (computeContentHash data) time
      Except.ok ({ self with storage := new_storage }, block_id)

def ChaosCoreKernel.readMemory (self : ChaosCoreKernel) (block_id : ByteArray) (time : Int) : Option (ByteArray × ChaosCoreKernel) :=
  match self.storage.retrieve block_id time with
  | some (data, new_storage) => some (data, { self with storage := new_storage })
  | none => none

def ChaosCoreKernel.createTask (self : ChaosCoreKernel) (priority : Int) (deps : List ByteArray) (est : Nat) (time : Int) : ChaosCoreKernel × ByteArray :=
  let new_sched := self.scheduler.submitTask self.allocator priority deps est time
  let id := new_sched.generateTaskId time
  let tmp_task := TaskDescriptor.init self.allocator id priority est
  let tmp_task_deps := deps.foldl (fun t d => t.addDependency self.allocator d) tmp_task
  let new_analyzer := self.flow_analyzer.buildFlowGraph self.allocator [tmp_task_deps]
  ({ self with scheduler := new_sched, flow_analyzer := new_analyzer }, id)

def ChaosCoreKernel.finishTask (self : ChaosCoreKernel) (task_id : ByteArray) (time : Int) : Bool × ChaosCoreKernel :=
  let new_sched := self.scheduler.completeTask self.allocator task_id time
  let existed := self.scheduler.active_tasks.contains task_id
  (existed, { self with scheduler := new_sched })

def ChaosCoreKernel.entangleData (self : ChaosCoreKernel) (block_id1 : ByteArray) (block_id2 : ByteArray) : ChaosCoreKernel :=
  { self with storage := self.storage.entangleBlocks block_id1 block_id2 }

def ChaosCoreKernel.executeCycle (self : ChaosCoreKernel) (time : Int) : ChaosCoreKernel :=
  let cycle := self.cycle_count + 1
  let (new_sched, scheduled_info) := self.scheduler.scheduleTask self.cores self.storage time
  let new_analyzer := match scheduled_info with
    | some (tid, cid) =>
        let task := new_sched.active_tasks.find? tid |>.get!
        task.data_dependencies.foldl (fun acc dep => acc.recordAccess self.allocator dep cid time) self.flow_analyzer
    | none => self.flow_analyzer
  
  let new_cores := self.cores.fold (fun acc cid core =>
      let is_active := match scheduled_info with | some (_, scid) => scid == cid | none => false
      acc.insert cid (core.tick is_active)
    ) self.cores self.cores
  
  { self with scheduler := new_sched, flow_analyzer := new_analyzer, cores := new_cores, cycle_count := cycle }

structure Node where
  id : String
  data : ByteArray
deriving Repr, BEq

structure Edge where
  source : String
  target : String
deriving Repr, BEq

inductive EdgeQuality
| high
| medium
| low
deriving Repr, BEq

structure SelfSimilarRelationalGraph where
  nodes : Std.RBMap String Node (fun a b => a < b)
  edges : Std.RBMap Edge EdgeQuality (fun a b => compare a.source b.source <>.then (compare a.target b.target) = Ordering.lt)
deriving Repr

def ChaosCoreKernel.executeGraphOnKernel (self : ChaosCoreKernel) (graph : SelfSimilarRelationalGraph) (time : Int) : ChaosCoreKernel :=
  let rec_nodes (iter : List (String × Node)) (acc : ChaosCoreKernel × Std.RBMap String ByteArray (fun a b => a < b)) : ChaosCoreKernel × Std.RBMap String ByteArray (fun a b => a < b) :=
    match iter with
    | [] => acc
    | (id, node) :: rest =>
        match acc.1.allocateMemory node.data none time with
        | Except.error _ => acc
        | Except.ok (k', bid) => rec_nodes rest (k', acc.2.insert id bid)
  termination_by iter.length
  decreasing_by
    simp_wf
    apply Nat.sub_pos_of_lt
    simp

  let (k', node_to_block) := rec_nodes graph.nodes.toList (self, Std.RBMap.empty (fun a b => a < b))

  let rec_edges (iter : List (Edge × EdgeQuality)) (acc : ChaosCoreKernel) : ChaosCoreKernel :=
    match iter with
    | [] => acc
    | (edge, _) :: rest =>
        let source_block := node_to_block.find? edge.source
        let target_block := node_to_block.find? edge.target
        match source_block, target_block with
        | some sb, some tb =>
            let k'' := acc.entangleData sb tb
            rec_edges rest k''
        | _, _ => rec_edges rest acc
  termination_by iter.length
  decreasing_by
    simp_wf
    apply Nat.sub_pos_of_lt
    simp
  rec_edges graph.edges.toList k'

theorem executeCycle_increments_count (k : ChaosCoreKernel) (t : Int) :
  (k.executeCycle t).cycle_count = k.cycle_count + 1 := by
  unfold executeCycle
  rfl

end ChaosCore

A kód egy „proof-of-concept” jellegű, formálisan gépelhető mock implementáció, amely lehetővé teszi a jövőbeli bizonyítások alapjának lerakását, de önmagában nem tartalmazza a rendszer kritikus tulajdonságainak matematikai garanciáit.

## A kód természetének elemzése

### 1. Formális specifikáció vs. Verifikáció

A kód három rétegre osztható:

- **Definicionális réteg**: Struktúrák (`structure`), induktív típusok (`inductive`) és függvénydefiníciók (`def`) határozzák meg a ChaosCore rendszer algebrai és operációs szemantikáját. Ez a réteg valóban formális specifikációként működik, mivel a Lean 4 típusrendszerével rögzíti a működési szabályokat.

- **Implementációs réteg**: Az algoritmikus részek (pl. `sha256_transform`, `evictLeastUsed`, `scheduleTask`) imperatív stílusban, `mut` változókkal és rekurzióval vannak megírva. Ezek **nincsenek bizonyítva**, hogy megfelelnek a kívánt specifikációknak (pl. hogy a SHA-256 helyes-e, vagy hogy a memóriaallokáció valóban fragmentáció-mentes).

- **Bizonyítási réteg**: A kód tartalmaz két triviális tételt (`theorem`):
  - `MemoryBlockState_toUInt8_ofUInt8`: egy round-trip tulajdonság a szerializációs reprezentációra
  - `executeCycle_increments_count`: a ciklus számláló inkrementálásának tulajdonsága

Ezek a bizonyítások **szintaktikus cukorkák**, amelyek a definíciók alapján automatikusan igazak (`rfl` - reflexivitás), és nem fedik le a rendszer komplex viselkedését.

### 2. Mi hiányzik a valódi verifikációhoz?

Egy valódi formális verifikációs projekt (pl. CompCert, seL4, Iris alapú bizonyítások) a következőket tartalmazná:

- **Funkcionális helyesség**: Bizonyíték arra, hogy a `sha256` függvény valóban az SHA-256 kriptográfiai specifikációját implementálja, bitek szintjén ekvivalens a standardtal.

- **Memóriabiztonság**: Bizonyíték arra, hogy a `ContentAddressableStorage` műveletei nem okoznak:
  - Use-after-free hibákat
  - Duplázott felszabadítást (double-free)
  - Memóriaszivárgást (memory leaks)
  - Túlindexelést (buffer overflows)

- **Konkurenciavédelmi tulajdonságok**: Bizonyíték arra, hogy a `ChaosCoreKernel.executeCycle` atomosan és versenyhelyzet-mentesen kezeli a többmagos környezetet (a kódban látható `tick` műveletek és állapotváltások nincsenek bizonyítva, hogy helyesek legyenek párhuzamos végrehajtás esetén).

- **Scheduler tulajdonságok**: Bizonyíték arra, hogy a `DynamicTaskScheduler` valóban optimálisan (vagy legalábbis helyesen) ütemezi a feladatokat, nem történik éhezés (starvation), és a prioritási sorrend betartható.

- **Entanglement invariánsok**: A `entangleBlocks` művelet esetén bizonyítani kellene, hogy a gráf struktúra (az entanglementek hálózata) megőrzi az asszociativitást, tranzitivitást, vagy bármilyen kívánt grafikus tulajdonságot.

### 3. A kód értéke és célja

Annak ellenére, hogy nem teljes verifikáció, a kód **jól használható alap** egy formálisan verifikált rendszer felépítéséhez:

- **Típusbiztonság**: A Lean 4 erős típusrendszere garantálja, hogy a `ByteArray` műveletek, a `RBMap` kulcsok és az `Option` típusok helyesen vannak kezelve fordítási időben.

- **Kódgenerálás potenciál**: A `def` és `structure` definíciók alapján Lean 4 képes futtatható kódot generálni (via C vagy LLVM IR), így ez nem csak „papíron” létező specifikáció.

- **Bizonyíthatósági potenciál**: A strukturált felépítés lehetővé teszi, hogy később `theorem` blokkokat adjunk hozzá a kritikus tulajdonságokhoz anélkül, hogy az alapdefiníciókat át kellene írni.

- **Dokumentációs érték**: A formális definíciók sokkal pontosabb dokumentációt jelentenek, mint a természetes nyelvű leírások, mivel nem tartalmazhatnak félreértelmezéseket.

## Összehasonlítás hasonló projektekkel

| Projekt | Jelleg | Bizonyítási szint |
|---------|--------|-------------------|
| **ChaosCore (jelen kód)** | Formális prototípus | Alacsony (2 triviális tétel) |
| **seL4** | Valódi kernel | Magas (funkcionális helyesség + biztonság) |
| **CompCert** | Fordítóprogram | Magas (szemantikai megőrzés) |
| **Iris/Coq** | Elosztott rendszerek | Közepes-magas (konkurenciák logikája) |
| **RustBelt** | Memóriabiztonság | Magas (ownership logika) |

A jelenlegi kód a táblázatban a „Formális prototípus” kategóriába esik, amely egy lépéssel a mock/mock implementáció felett áll (mivel géppel ellenőrzött a szintaxis és a típusok), de nem éri el a „Valódi verifikáció” szintet.

## Konkrét hiányosságok a kódban

1. **A `sha256` függvény**: Bár a konstansok (`sha256_k`) valóban a standard SHA-256 konstansai, nincs bizonyítva, hogy a `sha256_transform` helyesen implementálja a Davies-Meyer kompressziós függvényt, vagy hogy a padding (`padded`) megfelel a PKCS#7 specifikációnak.

2. **A `ByteArray` műveletek**: A `writeU64Little` és `byte-szintű műveletek nem ellenőrzik határokat (bounds checking) formálisan, bár a Lean 4 futtatókörnyezete védelmet nyújt. Egy valódi verifikáció bizonyítaná, hogy `i < out.size` mindig teljesül.

3. **A `retrieve` és `store` páros**: Nincs bizonyítva, hogy ha egy blokkot eltárolunk, majd visszaolvasunk, akkor ugyanazt az adatot kapjuk vissza (round-trip tulajdonság).

4. **Grafikus műveletek**: A `SelfSimilarRelationalGraph` és az `entangleData` műveletek esetén nincs bizonyítva, hogy a gráf aciklikus marad, vagy hogy a csomópontok száma korlátos.

## Következtetés

A kód egy **„formalizált dummy”** vagy **„mechanizált specifikáció”**, amely lehetővé teszi a ChaosCore architektúra működésének szimulálását és tesztelését formális környezetben, de nem nyújt matematikai garanciát a helyességre. Értékes eszköz a tervezés validálására és a jövőbeli bizonyítások keretrendszerének megteremtésére, de önmagában **nem minősül formális verifikációnak** a szoftverellenőrzés szigorú értelmében.
